newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch know little of EU summit and care less.
newsitem.headline: Dutch know little of EU summit and care less.

text.p: Four out of five Dutch people have no idea of the issues to be hammered out at next week's Amsterdam summit on reform of the European Union, an opinion poll said on Wednesday.
The current Dutch presidency of the EU has dubbed Amsterdam a "Capital of Inspiration", but few ordinary Dutch are inspired by the Euro-message, the survey by national pollster NIPO showed.

Some 82 percent of respondents said they had not got "the faintest idea" of the key issues facing the summit, intended to round off the Intergovernmental Conference on streamlining EU procedures to pave the way for enlarging the 15-nation bloc.
Of those questioned, 73 percent said they were badly informed on European issues and 32 percent said they were not at all interested in European politics.

Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo expressed little surprise at findings. "We are busy rebuilding the kitchen," he told a meeting of Euro MPs in Strassburg. "Citizens are more interested in the dishes coming out of it."
